# MTBC Gene Atlas

> Gene-by-gene functional annotation records for the Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex (H37Rv / MTBC0 reference). Each record lists its evidence layers with their sources; the annotation status (dark, requalified, family_assigned) is a status of this atlas, not a proven function.

## Machine-readable access

- [Sitemap](https://mtbc.gclab.fr/sitemap.xml)
- [Gene record, one per locus](https://mtbc.gclab.fr/api/v1/genes/Rv0001): JSON, same path for every Rv locus
- [Gene list](https://mtbc.gclab.fr/api/v1/genes)
- [Microproteins](https://mtbc.gclab.fr/api/v1/microproteins) and [RNAs](https://mtbc.gclab.fr/api/v1/rnas)
- [Full dump of gene records](https://mtbc.gclab.fr/downloads/mtbc_atlas_genes.jsonl.gz) and its [manifest](https://mtbc.gclab.fr/downloads/mtbc_atlas_genes.manifest.json) (record count, sha256, build time)

## Notes

- A missing layer on a record is a missing record, not evidence of absence.
- The static API answers with content type text/html; the body is valid JSON.
- To cite: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20815246
